records.summary: PVCFC's official 2024 annual report is available as an English interactive report. It documents the corporation's identity, fertilizer portfolio, and three-plant production footprint without requiring a binary download.

stableFacts: The report identifies the company as PetroVietnam Ca Mau Fertilizer Joint Stock Company, abbreviated PVCFC, with listing code DCM.

Ca Mau NPK Plant has a stated capacity of 300,000 tonnes per year, while Korea-Vietnam NPK Plant has a stated design capacity of 360,000 tonnes per year.
The Ca Mau Fertilizer product family includes single fertilizers, NPK fertilizers, and premium organic fertilizers.

records.name: PVCFC Annual Report 2025
records.summary: PVCFC's official 2025 annual report provides an interactive report and an English PDF. This fixture retains only durable organization, product-portfolio, and production-facility facts; financial results, forecasts, and investment commentary are intentionally excluded.

stableFacts: PVCFC was established on March 9, 2011 and its primary business covers the production, trading, import, and export of fertilizers and petroleum chemicals for agriculture.
The 2025 report identifies three PVCFC plants: Ca Mau Fertilizer Plant, Ca Mau NPK Plant, and Korea-Vietnam NPK Plant.
Ca Mau NPK Plant has a stated capacity of 300,000 tonnes per year and uses liquefied-urea technology from Spain's ESPINDESA with principal equipment from EU and G7 countries.
Korea-Vietnam NPK Plant entered operation in December 2017 with a stated design capacity of 360,000 tonnes of NPK per year and technology licensed by INCRO of Spain.
PVCFC's fertilizer portfolio includes inorganic and organic products, single fertilizers such as urea, potassium, DAP, and ammonium sulphate, and more than 90 NPK formulations.
PVCFC inaugurated the Ca Mau Fertilizer Production Plant - Binh Dinh Facility in 2025 to support production and distribution for Central Vietnam and the Central Highlands.
